description: Preview pulling another plugin of the project into a plugin, changing nothing: per kind (skills, agents, MCP servers, files) the items it would `add`, those in `conflict` with the plugin (and whether they are `replaceable`) and the `identical` ones, the state of the rules, and the `sourceFingerprint` and `fingerprint` that plugins_pull needs with decisions. The source is read as it is now; an item's `libraryItemId` is the id of the source plugin's item. `source` is the plugin the content is taken from and `plugin` the one that receives it: each is the plugin's exact, case-sensitive name, or its id with `sourceById: true` / `pluginById: true` (see plugins_list). Both are required, both are plugins of the project and they must differ; the installed plugin is never assumed. A plugin of another project cannot be the source (pulling across projects exists only in the web app); for a library entry use library_merge.

plugin.description: Name of the plugin that receives the content, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin). Required.

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

source.description: Name of the plugin to pull from, or its id with sourceById. Required.

sourceById.description: `source` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --source-by-id).

name: plugins_pull_preview
title: Preview plugin pull
